Persistent project runtime

Hermes PM

A project-specific manager that can stay awake longer than any one coding session and keep the approved frontier moving.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The continuity layer

Hermes owns watching, scheduling, recovery, and escalation. It uses the PM plugins and delegates implementation to Claude Code, Codex, and other Ringer lanes.

Manager-only boundary

It runs the work without becoming the worker.

  • Reads the repository, accepted intent, and tracker before choosing work
  • Starts bounded Claude or Codex sessions for implementation
  • Watches Ringer completion and reviews returned receipts
  • Begins diagnosis when a ticket returns with an issue
  • Recomputes the ready frontier and continues until judgment is required

The management cycle

01Watchtracker + heartbeat
02Selectready outcome
03DelegatePM + Ringer
04Recoverfailure evidence
05Continuenext frontier

Current experiment

The persistence is real; the policy is still being measured.

The live PM bot is moving through tracker tickets and helping diagnose returned issues. The next evidence is whether it recovers reliably across tickets, preserves the right state, and reduces Joe’s attention cost. Proposed PM changes remain held until this trial produces enough operating evidence.
